Over 100 Hospitalized After Eating Chowmein at MP Village Fair

More than 100 children and 12 adults were hospitalized in Madhya Pradesh after consuming chowmein at a village fair. In a separate incident, 19 people, including six children, were admitted to a hospital in Palamu village with suspected food poisoning after attending a housewarming feast.
